The proof treats boundary and existence quantifiers, not just numerical examples.

value.rationale: This is a complete, uniform ordering for the first six-season period not classified by the source paper, in the natural resource-rich two-season subfamily explicitly motivated by its higher-period permutation question. It exhibits a strict management ranking valid over the entire growth/capacity domain and proves it by a nontrivial trace/positivity bridge, rather than delivering a routine special-case computation.
